summary: Comprehensive backend API testing of Matrix Finance completed. All 31 pytest tests PASSED (100%). Coverage: health, JWT auth flow (signup/login/me/logout/patch), wallets CRUD (all 6 types + cascade delete), transactions (income/expense/transfer + balance adjustments + delete-reversal), budgets (with computed 'spent' field), goals (all 7 kinds + contribute), plans (correct default checklist counts 8/6/5/6 for wedding/house/car/vacation + patch items), debts/investments/assets CRUD, analytics summary (net_worth, cash_flow, saving_rate, debt_ratio, health_score 0-100, 6-month trend, category_breakdown), Coach SSE chat streaming (verified delta events + [DONE]) + history persistence, and security (all protected endpoints return 401 without token). No MongoDB _id leaks detected in any response. AI Coach streaming with Claude Sonnet 4.6 works end-to-end.

minor.issue: Auth is checked inside handler via Header dependency, so Pydantic body validation runs BEFORE auth check. Requests missing/invalid JSON body return 422 (validation) instead of 401 (auth). Minor info-disclosure; consider using FastAPI Depends(get_current_user) so auth is enforced before body parsing.

action_items: (Optional/Minor) Refactor auth to a FastAPI dependency (Depends(get_current_user)) so 401 is returned before Pydantic 422 for unauthenticated write requests.

(Optional) Consider validating that transfer's to_wallet_id belongs to the same user (currently only checked implicitly by user_id in update filter, which is correct — but add explicit lookup for clearer 404 vs silent no-op).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~815 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into modules: auth.py, wallets.py, transactions.py, coach.py, analytics.py.
Auth check pattern is repeated in every endpoint (get_user_from_token(authorization)). Better UX and security via FastAPI Depends dependency.
All Mongo queries correctly exclude _id via projection {'_id': 0} — verified no leaks.
String 'id' field is used consistently instead of ObjectId — good practice.
startup event uses deprecated @app.on_event style — consider migrating to lifespan context manager (FastAPI 0.109+).
CORS is 'allow_origins=[*]' with allow_credentials=True — this combination is invalid per spec and browsers may reject. Should be tightened for production.
seed_data_creation: Each test session signs up a fresh user (alex+<epoch>@matrix.dev / password123) via /api/auth/signup which auto-seeds 2 wallets + 4 budgets. All test-created resources are prefixed TEST_ where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is stable and fully functional. Use tests in /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py as regression suite. SSE Coach endpoint requires up to 45s timeout. Signup auto-seeds starter data, so tests can rely on 'Cash' and 'Main Bank' wallets existing on a fresh user.
